run_vad_segments: run the vads script to compute voice activity detection segments from WAV audio files using rVADfast
run_rvad_function: run the rvad function to perform spectral flatness analysis and VAD on a 16kHz WAV file path
run_main_cli: run the main CLI with --rvad-home flag and pipe file list via stdin to extract VAD segments
review_rvad_function: review the rvad function which uses speechproc for spectral flux, pitch block detection, and SNR-based VAD
refactor_rvad_function: refactor the rvad function to support configurable thresholds for spectral flatness and VAD sensitivity
